eventDetail.scope: 2026 The 8th International Conference on Video, Signal and Image Processing (VSIP) will be held in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu, China during November 6-8, 2026. VSIP 2026 is sponsored by Jiangsu University of Science and Technology, China; hosted by Ocean College, Jiangsu University of Science and Technology, China. VSIP 2026 solicits contributions worldwide that illustrate research results, projects, surveys and industrial experiences in related fields of Video, Signal and Image Processing.
